sourceBoundary.mode: Original PreparedSource with an explicit minimal file closure
sourceBoundary.reason: Package export initializers are omitted to avoid unrelated visualization and capability re-exports. The original PreparedSource loader supplies namespace packages; all imported compiler, scheduler, runtime, kernel and dependency modules retain exact source bytes. This oracle covers the specified workflows, not a full-repository application import.

provenance.sourceNameNormalization: Repository-relative display paths; original semantic IR and hashes are preserved.

preparedSource.boundary: immutable local Python and V7 declarations; installed dependencies remain environment dependencies; no hostile-code sandbox

memory: Remove each delta.previous, delta.digest and delta.source_digest
Remove node.origin.source_digest in current nodes and delta snapshots
receipt: Remove source_digest, graph_chain, before_chain and configured_chain
Remove compute_ms, total_ms and timing_ms; apply the same rule to reconsideration receipts
normalization.preserved: All revisions, kinds, statuses, values, evidence, relationships, ordered deltas, SRC causes, commands, policy inputs and outcomes. Only implementation provenance and its propagated basis-dependent identities are aliased in expected; python retains all original identities and hashes.
normalization.raw_reference: python contains original graph and provenance hashes; volatile timing fields alone are omitted from raw receipts.
normalization.numeric_scope: These fixtures use safe integers. They do not establish equivalence for Python float versus int identity or integers outside the JavaScript safe-integer range.
normalization.basis_dependent_identities: Experiment/option identities include graph-chain basis, which includes the path-dependent Python source digest. For repeatable --check only, alias every node identity by its first delta occurrence and every graph-chain digest by delta sequence. Raw Python snapshots retain every original byte-valued identifier and hash.
normalization.ordered_views: After identity aliasing, sort availability.nodes and receipt.options by aliased id; their original order is a hash-key view, not the policy ranking. Delta order, commands, ranking inputs and all retained knowledge remain unchanged.
normalization.exact_replay: The TypeScript choice test separately injects the raw fixture source_digest as a controlled input to compare complete raw graph histories and identifiers. Production uses its own TypeScript manifest digest.
